description: Scrape Hacker News stories, comments, jobs, and users. All modes use the public Firebase + Algolia APIs — no auth, no proxy.

commentAuthorFilter.description: Only emit comments authored by one of these usernames (case-insensitive substring match).
commentAuthorFilter.title: Comment author allowlist

commentMinScore.description: Drop comments below this score. (Note: HN exposes comment scores only sporadically; comments without a score are kept.)
commentMinScore.title: Min comment score

dateRangeFrom.description: Drop items posted before this date (UTC). Empty = no lower bound.
dateRangeFrom.title: Date range from (ISO YYYY-MM-DD)

dateRangeTo.description: Drop items posted after this date (UTC). Empty = no upper bound.
dateRangeTo.title: Date range to (ISO YYYY-MM-DD)

domainAllowlist.description: Only emit stories whose URL host contains one of these substrings (case-insensitive). e.g. ['github.com','arxiv.org'].
domainAllowlist.title: Domain allowlist

domainBlocklist.description: Drop stories whose URL host contains one of these substrings. e.g. ['twitter.com','x.com'].
domainBlocklist.title: Domain blocklist

enableCommentHierarchy.description: When true, attach a nested `comments[]` array to each story (recursive replies). When false, comments are emitted as flat sibling records (one per row, with `parentId` and `depth`).
enableCommentHierarchy.title: Build comment tree

excludeDeadOrDeleted.description: Drop items flagged `dead: true` or `deleted: true` by Hacker News.
excludeDeadOrDeleted.title: Exclude dead/deleted

itemIds.description: Direct Hacker News item IDs (numeric strings or integers). Used when mode=`item`.
itemIds.title: Item IDs (mode=item)

maxComments.description: Cap on comments fetched per story. 0 = no comments. Default 0 (skip comments).
maxComments.title: Max comments per story

maxDepth.description: Maximum reply depth when fetching comments (only applies when `maxComments` > 0). Root comments are depth 0.
maxDepth.title: Max comment depth

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records (stories + comments + users combined).
maxItems.title: Max items

minCommentCount.description: Drop stories with fewer than this many comments.
minCommentCount.title: Min number of comments

minScore.description: Drop stories with fewer points than this. Comments are unaffected.
minScore.title: Min story score

mode.description: What to scrape. `topStories` / `newStories` / `bestStories` / `askStories` / `showStories` / `jobStories` walk the public feeds. `item` fetches specific item IDs (`itemIds`). `user` fetches profiles (`usernames`). `search` uses the Algolia HN API (`searchQuery`).
mode.title: Mode

searchQuery.description: Free-text query passed to the Algolia HN search API.
searchQuery.title: Search query (mode=search)

startUrls.description: Hacker News URLs to scrape directly. Supports `news.ycombinator.com/item?id=N` and `news.ycombinator.com/user?id=USER`. Each URL is converted to an item or user fetch.
startUrls.title: Start URLs (optional)

usernames.description: Hacker News usernames. Used when mode=`user`.
usernames.title: Usernames (mode=user)

title: Hacker News Scraper Input
